Proposition
[$\mathbb {CP}^n$ is Einstein with constant $2n+2$]

Source: petersen:page-0168 ↗ thm:pet-ch4-cpn-sectional-curvature $\mathrm{Ric}(X,X)=2n+2$ for every unit $X$ on $\mathbb {CP}^n$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch4-cpn-einstein \sketch Extend $i\bar X$ to an orthonormal basis of $\bar X^\perp $. In the sectional curvature formula of subsection 5.3, the complex line through $X$ contributes $4$, while each of the remaining $2n-2$ orthogonal directions contributes $1$. Hence $\operatorname {Ric}(X,X)=4+(2n-2)=2n+2$.

□
